You are applying a consolidated set of small, safe fixes from the final code review of the storage module. Work from `/Users/sumandra/projects/talium/code-econ`. Canonical interpreter: **`venv/bin/python`**. These are all non-DB changes (do NOT add DB-backed tests).

## Fix 1 — emit the declared `queries_loaded` log event (storage.md §8)
`src/server/storage/queries.py` `QueryCatalog.load` currently logs nothing, but §8 declares `queries_loaded {files, query_count}`. Add structured logging: import the module logger (`from .log import get_logger` — the module `src/server/storage/log.py` provides `get_logger(name="storage")`), and at the END of `load`, before `return cls(out)`, emit `get_logger().info("queries_loaded", files=<count of *.yaml files scanned>, query_count=len(out))`. Track the file count via a small counter as you glob. Do not change the catalog's behavior otherwise.

## Fix 2 — document the engine-wiring seam (tracked follow-up)
Selecting `producer_store.backend: postgres` returns `PgProducerStore()`, but its methods call `session_scope()` which raises `RuntimeError` unless `server.storage.get_engine(cfg)` was called at process startup. Nothing in this branch wires that (the server bootstrap is a future module). Add a clear class docstring to `PgProducerStore` in `src/server/storage/producer_store.py` stating: "Requires the storage engine to be initialized once at process startup via `server.storage.get_engine(cfg)`; every method uses the shared `session_scope()`. Selecting the `postgres` producer-store backend without that bootstrap will raise RuntimeError on first use. TODO(storage): server bootstrap wiring is a future module." Do NOT change runtime behavior.

## Fix 3 — comment the init bootstrap gap (Minor)
In `src/server/storage/dbm/operations.py` `init()`, add a brief comment where it returns "exists" (the `if set(Base.metadata.tables) & existing:` branch) noting: partial/corrupt schemas are treated as "exists" and not repaired; and that phase-1 `create_all` (no migrations) intentionally does not stamp alembic — the phase-2 baseline (`db baseline`/first revision) is where stamping begins (storage.md §6). Comment only, no behavior change.

## Constraints
- No "Claude" anywhere. Keep changes minimal and focused; do not touch DB test behavior.

## Verify & commit
Run `venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/server/storage/ -q` (expect same as before: prior passes + 8 DB skips, 0 failed) and `venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` (whole repo green). Confirm `venv/bin/python -c "from server.storage.queries import QueryCatalog; QueryCatalog.load('config/queries')"` runs without error (emits the log). Commit: `fix(storage): emit queries_loaded log, document engine-wiring seam and init bootstrap gap`.
